description: Push DataFrame rows as OpenTelemetry log records via OTLP/HTTP. Same universal-backend story as the metrics sink.

body_column.label: Body Column
body_column.description: Column whose value becomes the log body. If unset, JSON-serializes the row.

severity_column.label: Severity Column
severity_column.description: Column with severity strings (TRACE/DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR/FATAL). Defaults to INFO for every row.

timestamp_column.label: Timestamp Column
timestamp_column.description: Column with epoch-seconds (or pandas datetime). Default: now() per row.

attribute_columns.label: Attribute Columns
attribute_columns.description: Columns whose values become OTel log attributes

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily'/'weekly'/'monthly'/'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values; 'dynamic' for values added at runtime; 'multi' for date × static. Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning.
